payload.body: dc: (1) The README's two fixes are in, banked on dc/wp13-docs at e4c044b. check all reads 'every read-only gate; bin/devbin help check names them', with no list, since there is no .tool-versions. The dev bullet now says pplr use dev links target/release/pplr, made with tools/build --release, and that use dev refuses without it, naming that step (install.rs:387). (2) intent/llm/ARCHITECTURE.md is drafted for your review: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Pplr/da774a51-7916-4f68-b76b-37c788cb4a76/scratchpad/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, with the diff at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Pplr/da774a51-7916-4f68-b76b-37c788cb4a76/scratchpad/docs/ARCHITECTURE.diff. It replaces the seed text with the shape and the reasons behind it, pointing at ST0001's design.md (D1 to D11) and ST0002's design.md and install-release.md for the decisions rather than restating them. Its sections: one binary with the data outside it (D11, D6, no run-time build, no checkout, and what breaks: the brew tree); the command table (cli.rs, the thin main, the commands that need no tree, rewrite_args, hand-rolled parsing for byte parity); pure core and impure edges (the pure modules and emitters against fs, tree, contacts, mail and the coordinators; the one About reader, read_text and read_exact, of decision 10; write_atomic); byte for byte (the frozen goldens; why the writers are hand-written: jq's and Python's JSON, PyYAML-style YAML 1.1, the plist templates, fold_table from Foundation, which also decomposes the .inetloc names as Foundation did, and PPLR_TODAY); Contacts behind one Store (the diagram; why Swift for the sidecar, and why AppleScript writes; swiftc with no Package.swift); Mail (rusqlite, schema checks, email --json's schema 1); the install layout (layout.rs, install.rs T1 to T10, handler.rs, the release); platforms (D9 as the code gates it); and tests and gates (unit, cli.rs, bats with PPLR_UNDER_TEST's dev default, check all and test all without a list, the pre-commit gate, CI on candidate/**, and tools/nopython in cc's words). Every claim is checked against src at c4929d0. I dropped a golden count, because cases/ holds the LEGACY file beside the 54 cases and a count drifts. It describes C1 to C5's tree (no fallback, the sidecar cut, nopython), so it lands after C5 with the README and the CHANGELOG. Prettier passes, it is ASCII only, and people-leak is clean. (3) The CHANGELOG draft has one line you have not seen, from cc's C7: under Changed, 'pplr doctor no longer looks for jq, which nothing pplr runs needs' (0983fc9). (4) CLAUDE.md's pointers are next. I'll base them on cc's C1 and C4 edits.
